description:
Authentic vintage Lalique "Pinsons" Crystal Bowl (model 11016), originally designed by Ren Lalique in 1933.
Features a molded relief pattern of small finches (pinsons) nestled among arched, serrated leaves and foliage.
Material: Crafted from clear and frosted (satin-finished) pressed crystal.
Handwritten "Lalique France" script mark.
Era: The elegant cursive script with no letter "R" means it was made after 1945. Pieces made during Ren Lalique’s lifetime usually feature a blocky, molded "R. LALIQUE" mark. After his death in 1945, his son Marc dropped the "R" and began using hand-engraved cursive scripts.Signature Authenticity: Authentic post-war Lalique signatures are typically tiny, thin, and lightly hand-etched or scribe-signed. They are carefully tucked away between the frosted leaves or on the outer bottom edge so they do not ruin the artwork.
Dimensions: Measures approximately 9.25 inches in diameter and 3.75 inches in height.

The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

description:
This listing includes a large clear plastic zipper bag filled with a variety of miscellaneous semi precious stones. The collection contains assorted rocks, minerals, and gemstones in rough, unpolished forms as well as tumbled stones. Colors include green, purple, clear, and brown. The stones vary in size from small chips to larger chunks. The bag is a Great Value brand storage zipper bag. Condition is used with visible dust and natural wear on the stones. Suitable for rock collectors, educational use, or crafting projects.
Grab Bag Policy

*Lot may contain other items or sets that are not fully related to contents of grab bag. Examples include: non-branded or off brand versions, similar size items, and/ or small toys mixed in with lot.

*There is no guarantee on rarity or completeness of any sets that may be included in a grab bag. 

*Grab bags come as is with no refunds or returns. 

* We are unable to answer questions about specific items within a grab bag. Please view the provided photographs to determine general contents.

*Due to the nature of donations used items may have unforeseen damage not noted in the description. 

*Some items may come with batteries or other accessories. Unless stated we do not test each part of the item. Some functions may be untested.

description:
Vintage heavy solid-brass Western-style belt buckle featuring a detailed raised Wells Fargo & Co. / Onion Valley mining-camp scene with three figures gathered around a table, firearms and Old West details. Reverse is marked “Wells Fargo and Co. Ex.” and carries the distinctive “Rare Stones / Tiffany / Broadway New York” marking.
This buckle belongs to the collectible Wells Fargo/Tiffany-marked fantasy or reproduction buckle series, generally attributed to the late 1950s–1960s.
Approx. Dimensions: 4" W × 3" H; rear belt loop approximately 2½" wide.
Material: Heavy cast brass/brass alloy. Condition: Good vintage condition with surface scratches, scuffs, age-related patina/tarnish and finish wear. Reverse shows noticeable abrasion and solder/brazing around the applied markings and belt hardware, consistent with manufacture and age. Hardware appears intact. Please review photos for exact condition.
